displayPattern: Front-load washer display shows F8 E1 or LO FL
meaning: Low water flow: the washer is sensing a low flow of water.
causes: Household water supply or hot/cold faucets not fully open
Anti-flood hoses or controls in the water line
diySteps: Check the household water supply is on and both the cold and hot faucets or valves are fully open
Check the water inlet hoses are not kinked
Check there are no anti-flood hoses or controls in the water line connected to the washer
Press the Pause or Cancel button twice and the Power button once to clear the code
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If the code returns after these checks, Whirlpool says to contact it or schedule service online.
sourceTitle: Error Codes in Front Load Washers (Whirlpool Product Help)
